title: 第29章 都尉
content_zh:
“这么快？”

    走访了一天的魏乐府回去后，得知今天一天沈千钧就抓住了三名莲香教人员。

    并且沈千钧正在拷打他们，已经问出了不少情报。

    这可让魏乐府惊讶不已，这开挂了吧？？？

    “我也觉得奇怪。”田牧川更是紧皱眉头，这事太蹊跷了。

    “据我所知，他都没有调查吧，就直扑过去抓人。”

    “然后还一抓一个准。”

    “你说，会不会他勾结莲香教亦或者是他本身就是莲香教的人？”

    倒也不是田牧川栽赃诬陷，主要是这确实有点违反常理。

    直接跳过过程得知结果。

    说实话，魏乐府都怀疑沈千钧真有这种能力。

    不然修炼能这么快，万一真是直接跳过过程呢？

    “可能性不大。”魏乐府摇摇头说道：“如果他真是的话，不可能这么跳。”

    “大人，如果你想用这个法子去排挤沈千钧是行不通的。”

    “他真能抓到莲香教的人，上官大人也会袒护他的。”

    上官疏桐最多只是会留个心眼并且多加监视，等事后再进行调查。

    现在根本不可能会动沈千钧的。

    田牧川也是明白这个道理，之所以会跟魏乐府说，是想着看看有什么好的解决办法。

    但看魏乐府这情况，肯定也是没有了。

    最终也只能叹了一口气。

    “这次风头和功劳，恐怕是要落到沈千钧头上了。”田牧川只得这么说。

    “那大人，柳林县情况怎么样？”魏乐府又问道。

    “不清楚，情报被上官大人都截留了。”田牧川略带郁闷地回答。

    魏乐府却能听得出来，这怕是不容乐观。

    说不定大败而归都有可能，不然真要是捷报怎么可能藏着掖着。

    就现在这局面，也只能报喜不报忧了。

    二人正聊着，就有下人进来禀报。

    “老爷、丁大人，洪都尉前来拜见。”
content_en:
"So fast?"

After visiting Wei Yuefu for a day, he learned that Shen Qianjun had captured three Lianxiang Cult members today.

Moreover, Shen Qianjun was torturing them and had already asked for a lot of information.

This surprised Wei Yuefu. Is this cheating???

"I find it strange too." Tian Muchuan frowned even more, this was so strange.

"As far as I know, he didn't even investigate, he just went straight to arrest people."

"And then he catches every one accurately."

"Tell me, is it possible that he has colluded with the Lotus Sect or is he a member of the Lotus Sect?"

It's not that Tamaki Chuan framed him, the main thing is that this is indeed a bit contrary to common sense.

Skip the process directly to get the result.

To be honest, Wei Yuefu even doubted that Shen Qianjun really had such ability.

Otherwise, cultivation can be so fast, what if the process is skipped directly?

"It's unlikely." Wei Yuefu shook his head and said, "If he was real, he wouldn't be able to jump like that."

"Sir, if you want to use this method to exclude Shen Qianjun, it won't work."

"If he really catches people from the Lotus Sect, Lord Shangguan will protect him."

At most, Shangguan Shutong would just keep a careful eye and monitor him more, and then investigate later.

It is impossible to touch Shen Qianjun now.

Tian Muchuan also understood this truth, and the reason why he told Wei Yuefu was to see if there was any good solution.

But looking at the situation in Wei Yuefu, it is definitely gone.

In the end, I could only sigh.

"I'm afraid the limelight and credit this time will fall on Shen Qianjun." That's all Tian Muchuan could say.

"My lord, how is the situation in Liulin County?" Wei Yuefu asked again.

"I don't know, the information was intercepted by Lord Shangguan." Tian Muchuan answered slightly depressed.

But Wei Yuefu could tell that this was not optimistic.

Maybe it's possible to return with a big defeat, otherwise how could it be possible to hide the good news.

In this current situation, we can only report the good news but not the bad news.

While the two were chatting, a servant came in to report.

"Master, Lord Ding, Captain Hong is here to pay his respects."
